segments.name: Shopping Malls
segments.description: Acquires, develops and manages shopping malls in Argentina, earning lease and service revenue from commercial space tenants.
segments.evidence: "Shopping Malls" segment includes results principally comprised of lease and service revenues related to rental of commercial space and other spaces in the shopping malls of the Company.

segments.name: Offices
segments.description: Owns, develops and manages office buildings throughout Argentina, earning lease and service revenues from office tenants.
segments.evidence: "Offices" segment includes the operating results from lease revenues of offices and other service revenues related to the office activities.

segments.name: Sales and developments
segments.description: Develops, maintains and sells undeveloped parcels of land and trading properties, including residential projects.
segments.evidence: "Sales and Developments" segment includes the operating results of the development, maintenance and sales of undeveloped parcels of land and/or trading properties.

segments.name: Hotels
segments.description: Operates hotels, earning revenues mainly from rooms, catering and restaurant services.
segments.evidence: "Hotels" segment includes the operating results mainly comprised of room, catering and restaurant revenues.

segments.name: Others
segments.description: Entertainment activities and financial activities, plus other investments in associates such as Banco Hipotecario.
segments.evidence: "Others" segment includes the entertainment activities through La Arena S.A., La Rural S.A. and Centro de Convenciones Buenos Aires (concession), Shefa and the financial activities carried out through BHSA / BACS, as well as other investments in associates.

revenueModel.text: Tenants and customers pay the company lease and service revenues for commercial and office space, hotel rooms and catering, and property sales.
revenueModel.evidence: "Shopping Malls" segment includes results principally comprised of lease and service revenues related to rental of commercial space and other spaces in the shopping malls of the Company.
